text:
alex.k: Quick idea 1: run a 4-week ISV sandbox called 'Sandcastle' to onboard LangChain + LlamaIndex adapters and gateway/orchestrator flows. Anyone free for a brief sync?

priya.r: Sounds good. What are our success metrics? Fast adapter onboarding, CI smoke tests passing, and marketplace-ready artifacts?

sam.w: Ill own infra. Need an isolated VPC, ephemeral creds, and a starter adapter template.

marie: Security items: KMS integration, block external log sinks, RBAC for partner seats. @sam.w can you draft the infra manifest?

sam.w: Draft manifest for discussion:
```
sandbox:
  name: sandcastle-isv-pilot
  adapters: [langchain, llamindex]
  gateway: redwood-gateway-v2
  network: vpc-sandcastle-pilot
  creds: ephemeral
  quotas: 50k-tokens/day
```
Will iterate after partner kickoff.

jordan: Ops: autoscale off for pilot, disable batching initially, and monitor latency closely. Set alerts for 200ms p95 regressions.

alex.k: Good. First-wave partners: FlowForge and ChainForge. Include Dedicated -> Private fallback validation in scope.

priya.r: Marketing wants co-branded "how-to" + joint blog. Can engineering deliver a minimal onboarding guide in 2 weeks?

sam.w: Two weeks for a minimal guide + code samples is tight but possible. Need partners to approve sample prompts and eval sets.

dev-bot: deploy-bot: sandbox-alpha env created: sandcastle-alpha-1720304. Logs: https://internal.corp/logs/sandcastle-alpha

marie: I'll start the security review: block log sinks, add KMS config, ephemeral key rotation, and a short threat model. Target complete by EOD Wed.

alex.k: Next steps: sam - infra PR by Tue; marie - security review Wed; priya - partner comms draft by Thu; alex - partner kickoff Fri 10am.

priya.r: Ill do Fri 10.

sam.w: Works for me.

jordan: Booked.

marie: Adding checklist + action items to shared doc: https://drive.redwood/sandcastle-checklist

alex.k: Thanks team. Keep updates in this thread. Ping me for blockers.
